hard_constraints: Produce optimized.stl as one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume solid.
Stay inside the stated coordinate envelope, above the minimum spans, and within the material-volume range.
Provide at least 170 mm^2 of actual z=0 contact in each specified simple-support zone.
Provide at least 20 mm^2 in each specified z>=40 mm center-load bearing patch.
Every sampled Y-Z section from x=5 through x=125 must be one connected load path.
Minimum effective I_y must be at least 75000 mm^4, calculated center deflection at most 0.03 mm, and calculated bending stress at most 12 MPa.
Do not read ground_truth, edit eval.py, or fabricate score or metric files.
invalid_conditions: Missing, unparsable, empty, or implausibly small STL geometry.
A non-watertight, inverted, disconnected, or non-positive-volume solid.
Coordinate-envelope, bounding-span, volume, support-contact, load-bearing, section-connectivity, inertia, deflection, or stress violation.
Native project files used as the only deliverable.

load_case.model: Euler-Bernoulli simply supported beam with center point load distributed through two bearing patches

metric: (48 * E * minimum sampled I_y / L^3) / material volume; higher calculated stiffness per volume is better
objective: Maximize calculated vertical bending stiffness per material volume under the documented support, load, and material assumptions.
